errors.evidence: Both axes represent different data but are not dual; the y-axis is not labeled as having a right and left axis.
The machine-generated description suggests a maximum value for contracts of approximately 900, while the actual maximum is much higher (e.g., 852).
The description does not mention the use of markers (small circles) for the data points.
The description omits the specific range of the y-axis for the number of contracts, especially the intervals or specific values.
The description does not explicitly state the purpose of the chart regarding the trends in contracts as mentioned in the reference.
